title: 棱角两面脚步
description: 彩铅突出成人双脚分别踏在棱角两面的低脚点，身体自然转向。

art_direction.medium: opaque gouache illustration with broad matte brush marks
art_direction.scene: An original colored-pencil illustration shows a fictional adult placing the shoes on positive footholds across both faces of a low rounded arete. The feet remain close to thick continuous crash mats, broad coral handholds provide relaxed support, and the hips turn naturally toward the next nearby edge. Keep the stance moderate, with no forced split or suspended twist. Frame the full clothed figure in a three-quarter medium-wide view so the two wall faces and every shoe contact remain clear. Use warm paper grain, teal pencil shadows, and muted rust clothing. The landing zone is empty. Include no captions, brands, jumping, dangerous exposure, or exaggerated anatomy.
